storage.title: Storage Permission Required
storage.description: This extension needs storage permission to save your filter preferences and provide a better experience.

offscreen.title: Additional Permission Required
offscreen.description: This extension needs the offscreen permission to process downloads efficiently.
offscreen.why: This permission allows the extension to create background documents for processing large downloads without affecting your browsing experience.

global.title: Permissions Required
global.description: This extension needs storage and offscreen permissions to provide the best download experience.

storage.title: Storage Permission:
storage.description: Allows the extension to save small amounts of data locally in your browser. This enables us to remember your preferences and provide a personalized experience across sessions.

offscreen.title: Offscreen Permission:
offscreen.description: Enables large file downloads by allowing the extension to process files in the background without affecting your browsing experience.

privacy.title: Privacy:
privacy.local: All data stays local in your browser
